purpose_context: Part of the whole-pack round trip (epic #186, issue #193). Assets (a sidecar descriptor plus a file payload) and top-level templates are loaded into the charter domain with their metadata and written back byte-for-byte, so the whole-pack round-trip gate turns green for these kinds and pack authors can trust the service not to lose or alter their scripts, documents, fonts and images.
purpose_tldr: Read every asset and template of a Charter Pack into the domain and write it back unchanged.
